title: Research evidence and verification policy
acceptance_rules: Do not mark PASS, defect, or complete when browser, authentication, device, or end-to-end checks were not performed.
Do not infer direct verification from a search snippet, free-text claim, dispatch success, agent completion, or final approval.
Use GET-only investigation for public pages by default; do not bypass login, write to production, or modify external systems unless explicitly approved.
Record each agent's scope, constraints, incomplete checks, and recommended follow-up verification in the result.
